name: FastH3 Omni (Official)
description: Official Draw Things preset for FastH3 Omni, an 8-step H3 ref2va video model
notes: 8-step distilled MiniMax H3 [ref2va] (reference-to-video): generates 24 fps video with synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. Requires at least one reference image (canvas/moodboard), identified in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc. Official recipe: 768-pixel short side, 8 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, Shift 12, Audio Shift 3. 73 frames = 8n+1 (valid 9-257); ~3s of video at 24 fps. Override frames with --num-frames.
